semantic_deltas.detail: Normed real vector space for locality/partial recursion; inherited complete real inner-product context only for extended one-step parent. Generic logical specs accept arbitrary eta/V/loss; source performance restricted as above.

Algorithm argmin notation does not supply an existence proof. Option exposes non-attainment instead of inventing a point; completed runs satisfy the actual update. Source T15.30 separately assumes iterates interior. Full same-run theorem and source hypothesis transport remain mandatory.

Source psi:X->R handled by agreement of ambient representatives on X at interior bases; no ambient default derivative at boundary is licensed. Mathlib existing local derivative APIs reused; no duplicate derivative-theory library.

required_reader_corrections.R1: Source Definition6.4 has target in X and derivative base in interior X; ambient representative agreement only licenses that ordered domain. Do not infer boundary derivative validity, positivity or invariance of selected trajectories.
required_reader_corrections.R2: advance is noncomputable current-function argmin selection with explicit feasible membership; none means no attained feasible minimum, not optimizer timeout. Generic eta, V and EReal losses may be improper or infinite.
required_reader_corrections.R3: iterate starts some x0 and binds current eta t/loss t; source prediction round t+1 is state(t+1). Whole-function prefix equality below t determines state t, not ordinary pre-current-loss OGD.
required_reader_corrections.R4: Absorbing none and completion are conditional: local attainment concerns actual reached states below T. T0 may return an infeasible x0; no unconditional attainment or interior preservation follows.
required_reader_corrections.R5: Signed one-step must use the same actual consecutive states and derive their feasible minimum, with positive current eta, proper/global supports, convex V and BOTH derivatives. Preserve both negative ordered residuals and finite-value justification.
required_reader_corrections.R6: Generic locality/recursion use real normed spaces without completeness or finite dimension; final one-step inherits complete real inner-product context. Source finite Euclidean specialization and X/interior transport remain explicit.

theorem divergence_extension_eq (X : Set E) (ψ φ : E → ℝ)

theorem advance_some_spec (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
    (f : E → EReal) (x p : E) (h : advance V ψ η f x = some p) :
    p ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p

    advance V ψ η f x = none ↔ ¬ ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p

theorem iterate_complete_of_step_attained (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)

    (hatt : ∀ t < T, ∀ x, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x →
      ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧

frozen_targets.exact_proposed_header:
theorem iterate_one_step (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (ψ : E → ℝ)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 x p : E) (t : ℕ)
    (hx : iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x)
    (hp : iterate V ψ η loss x0 (t + 1) = some p)
    (hη : 0 < η t) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) (hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ p) :
    ∀ u ∈ V, η t * ((loss t p).toReal - (loss t u).toReal) ≤
      divergence ψ u x - divergence ψ u p - divergence ψ p x

frozen_definitions.exact_definition:
def advance (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Option E := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p
    then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def iterate (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) : ℕ → Option E
  | 0 => some x0
  | t + 1 => (iterate V ψ η loss x0 t).bind (advance V ψ (η t) (loss t))
